messages:
Sophie (partnerships): Quick heads up — we got NVIDIA + AWS marketplace co-marketing for a hybrid webinar + booth at EdgeCon on Oct 12. Need to lock speakers, demo infra, and swag routing. Who can own the run of show?

Raj (eng-demo): I can own the demo stack and run-of-show for the demo portion.

Lila (product): Perfect. Speakers we should aim for: Sophie (intro), Raj (live demo), Priya (NVIDIA tech), plus a 10-min customer spot if we can get one. Agree?

Priya (NVIDIA): Yep — Priya here. NVIDIA will support with 2x 80GB nodes and an on-site engineer. We need final slide deck and co-brand logos by Sept 5 for approvals.

Andrew (hardware): For the DGX units we'll need a 24h pre-show test window. Also confirm network requirements — will the demo run in our VPC or on-site? If on-site, we need a static IP and VPN drop.

Matt (infra): Ideally run from Redwood Dedicated in AWS for staging, then a local fallback on NVIDIA kit for the live run. Raj, can you add a KV cache warmup step in the flow so latency is stable for the demo?

Raj (eng-demo): Yes — I'll bake a prefix cache strategy. Draft demo steps below:
```
1) warmup: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/70b-q4/health
2) load prompt set from s3://edgeconf-demo/prompts
3) run batch inference with --streaming false for deterministic timing
4) fallback test: spin local model on NVIDIA DGX with docker-compose demo-compose.yml
```

Jessica (marketing): Swag: marketing prefers co-branded neoprene sleeves, 500 stickers, and 200 enamel pins. Budget OK but need shipping addr for partner co-pack. We have SF warehouse (addr below) or we can ship directly to conference freight. Which do you prefer?

Sophie (partnerships): Let's ship to SF warehouse for quality check, then consolidated freight to venue. Priya — will NVIDIA co-pack swag and add a small insert?

Priya (NVIDIA): Yes, we can co-pack. We need the sleeve artwork in EPS by Sept 5. Also confirm logo size and clearance.

Andrew (hardware): I'll coordinate freight pick-up. Shipping address (SF warehouse): Redwood Logistics, 250 Mission St, SF, CA 94105. ETA for vendor cut-off is Oct 1.

Jessica (marketing): Noted. I'll create a PO with vendor link: https://swagco.example/orders/98321 — need purchase sign-off by Aug 28.

Sophie (partnerships): AV & booth ops: who books A/V for the partner table and the webinar stream? We should have a backup HDMI and a recorded fallback in case live API has issues.

Matt (infra): I'll book a remote recording VM to capture the demo stream. Also request booth HDMI passthrough and a local laptop with model docker image as fallback.

Raj (eng-demo): Proposing a fallback flow: pre-recorded 5-min video of the exact demo + live Q&A. That way if token limits or network flake we switch to video. :+1:

Lila (product): Great. Can someone draft a 12-minute run-of-show timeline? I'll take speaker transitions.

Sophie (partnerships): I'll draft the run-of-show and tag owners. Action items from this thread:
- Sophie: produce run-of-show (due Aug 18)
- Raj: demo checklist + code + prefix cache (due Aug 25)
- Matt: recording VM + AV list (due Aug 25)
- Jessica: PO for swag + artwork reqs (due Aug 10)
- Andrew/Priya: confirm on-site nodes and pre-show test window (due Aug 20)

Jessica (marketing): I'll also create a small signup form for speaker bios and headshots. Link soon. :tada:

Priya (NVIDIA): We'll send an equipment tech brief and on-site contact. Expect an email from priya@nvidia.com with the details.

deploy-bot: Reminder: created calendar event "EdgeCon — Redwood x NVIDIA Webinar + Booth" for Oct 12; invites sent to participants.

Sophie (partnerships): Thanks all — I'll convert this into a shared Notion runbook and ping you when it's ready. Please react with :thumbsup: if you can meet the listed dates.

Raj (eng-demo): :thumbsup:

Lila (product): :thumbsup:

Matt (infra): :thumbsup:

Jessica (marketing): :thumbsup:

Andrew (hardware): :thumbsup:

Priya (NVIDIA): :thumbsup:
